host.title: SFTP Host
host.description: SFTP server hostname or IP address

folder_path.title: Folder Path
folder_path.description: Path to folder containing SAS files on SFTP server (e.g., /folder/subfolder)

file_level_incremental.title: File-Level Incremental
file_level_incremental.description: Only process new or modified files based on last modification timestamp

data_level_incremental.title: Data-Level Incremental
data_level_incremental.description: Within each file, only load rows with timestamps newer than last processing

timestamp_column.title: Timestamp Column
timestamp_column.description: Column name containing timestamps for data-level incremental (required when Data-Level Incremental is enabled)

output.title: Output Settings
output.description: Configure how data is written to Keboola Storage

primary_key.title: Primary Key
primary_key.description: Column(s) to use as primary key in Keboola Storage

incremental.title: Incremental Write
incremental.description: Write to Keboola Storage in incremental mode (append/update)

preserve_insertion_order.title: Preserve Insertion Order
preserve_insertion_order.description: Maintain the order of rows from source SAS files

duckdb_max_memory_mb.title: DuckDB Maximum Memory (MB)
duckdb_max_memory_mb.description: Maximum memory allocation for DuckDB processing
